reproducibility_gaps: The paper defines the sample as the first 10,000 SCEDC events starting 2019-01-01, but the exact event-ID list, terminating timestamp, catalog query and catalog/version snapshot are not independently preserved.
The exact phase-pick file manifest/fields, station subset and file-level mapping used for the manuscript case study are not independently reconstructed.
SCEDC provides public-data access and an archive citation DOI, but no SPDX-standard licence was independently resolved for this portal-level resource; no data payload or API response was opened.
notes: R1 reflects an authoritative public data service and a verified paper relationship with a well-described 10,000-event selection rule.
R2 is withheld because the dynamic catalog snapshot, exact event IDs/files and exact retrieval query are not pinned.
No SCEDC payload or scientific workflow was executed.
